transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what finally made me schedule the appointment is that my appetite has just been all over the place for months now. 

I'll have these stretches where I just skip dinner completely, and I've actually lost some weight without even trying to. And then other nights, I'll just pick at crackers or maybe have a bowl of cereal, mostly because the thought of actually cooking a real meal for myself just feels... pointless right now. So, that's what brings me in.
Along with the changes in your appetite, how has your mood been feeling lately?

I haven't really noticed anything different with my mood, to be honest. I mean... I feel mostly fine, I think. I'm not really sure how to answer that, because it's really just the eating thing that stands out to me right now.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities or hobbies that you normally enjoy?

Well, I suppose I have. I still try to go through the motions of things I used to love doing. Like, I'll go out to water the garden, or I'll show up to my book club. But most of the time, it just feels... flat. I don't really get any enjoyment out of it right now, and I usually end up leaving early, or honestly, sometimes I just don't even start at all.
Did any major life changes or stressful events occur around the time these changes started?
Well, yes. Um... I suppose this has really been going on since my divorce was finalized. That was about a year and seven months ago now. So, yes, that would be the main thing.
Before this started after your divorce, have you ever experienced a period like this in your life?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had ups and downs like anyone else, but nothing that lasted this long or felt quite like this. So, no, this is the first time I've really dealt with something like this.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since this started?

Yes, I have. I can usually get into bed at a reasonable hour, but... I almost always wake up around four in the morning now. My mind just starts going, thinking about bills, or my case notes for work, or the divorce. And then I just lie there, completely exhausted, until my alarm finally goes off.
How have your energy levels been during the day?

Honestly, they've been pretty low. Even on days when my caseload isn't unusually heavy, I feel like I'm just... dragging my body through the hospital. And then by the time I get home, I'm just too tired to do much of anything. I don't have the energy to cook, or do my stretches, or even answer personal messages. I'm just completely wiped out by the end of the day.
How have you been feeling about yourself lately, such as having feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

I've been feeling pretty guilty, honestly. I just... I keep replaying the marriage in my head, and I keep telling myself that I must have failed at something really basic for things to fall apart like they did. I mean, part of me knows relationships are much more complicated than that—I see it in my line of work all the time—but it's just hard to shake that feeling that I messed it all up.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or feeling like you would be better off not waking up?

I don't have a plan to hurt myself, but... yes, I do sometimes catch myself thinking that it would just be a relief to not wake up. It actually scares me a little when I think about it. I mean, I know I would take it very seriously if one of my clients said something like that to me.
